Consider the diagram shown above, where QP→=a, ST→=b, RT→=c, and TP→=d. Find SQ→ in terms of a,b,c, and d.

a
SQ→=b+c+d
b
SQ→=a+b+d
c
SQ→=a+c+d
d
SQ→=b+d−a
e
SQ→=b+d−c
